segments.text: We need to identify which error type is present.
Source German: "Nowy Zyzdrój ist ein kleines Dorf in der polnischen Woiwodschaft Ermland-Masuren und gehört zur Landgemeinde Piecki im Powiat Mrągowski."
- "polnischen Woiwodschaft Ermland-Masuren" = Polish voivodeship of Warmian-Masurian (Ermland-Masuren).
Translation: "Nowy Zyzdréj is a big village in the Polish voivodship of Ermland-Masuren, in the rural municipality of Piecki in the county of Mrégowski."
So error type: Modifiers or Adjectives.
Also note spelling changes: Zyzdrój vs Zyzdréj, Mrągowski vs Mrégowski.
But the main error described is "big" vs "small".
The question: "The translation contains an error pertaining to" choose one.
The biggest error is the adjective change.
